verses.ar: لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ. لِبَنِي قُورَحَ. مَزْمُورٌ يَا جَمِيعَ ٱلْأُمَمِ صَفِّقُوا بِٱلْأَيَادِي. ٱهْتِفُوا لِلهِ بِصَوْتِ ٱلِٱبْتِهَاجِ.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah. O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ عَلِيٌّ مَخُوفٌ، مَلِكٌ كَبِيرٌ عَلَى كُلِّ ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: For the LORD most high [is] terrible; [he is] a great King over all the earth.
verses.web: For Yahweh Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.

verses.ar: يُخْضِعُ ٱلشُّعُوبَ تَحْتَنَا، وَٱلْأُمَمَ تَحْتَ أَقْدَامِنَا.
verses.kjv: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.
verses.web: He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet.

verses.ar: يَخْتَارُ لَنَا نَصِيبَنَا، فَخْرَ يَعْقُوبَ ٱلَّذِي أَحَبَّهُ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.kjv: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
verses.web: He chooses our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

verses.ar: صَعِدَ ٱللهُ بِهُتَافٍ، ٱلرَّبُّ بِصَوْتِ ٱلصُّورِ.
verses.kjv: God is gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.
verses.web: God has gone up with a shout, Yahweh with the sound of a trumpet.

verses.ar: رَنِّمُوا لِلهِ، رَنِّمُوا. رَنِّمُوا لِمَلِكِنَا، رَنِّمُوا.
verses.kjv: Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.
verses.web: Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱللهَ مَلِكُ ٱلْأَرْضِ كُلِّهَا، رَنِّمُوا قَصِيدَةً.
verses.kjv: For God [is] the King of all the earth: sing ye praises with understanding.
verses.web: For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.

verses.ar: مَلَكَ ٱللهُ عَلَى ٱلْأُمَمِ. ٱللهُ جَلَسَ عَلَى كُرْسِيِّ قُدْسِهِ.
verses.kjv: God reigneth over the heathen: God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.
verses.web: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.

verses.ar: شُرَفَاءُ ٱلشُّعُوبِ ٱجْتَمَعُوا. شَعْبُ إِلَهِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ. لِأَنَّ لِلهِ مَجَانَّ ٱلْأَرْضِ. هُوَ مُتَعَالٍ جِدًّا.
verses.kjv: The princes of the people are gathered together, [even] the people of the God of Abraham: for the shields of the earth [belong] unto God: he is greatly exalted.
verses.web: The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted!
